title: Windsurf vs Cursor
summary: Windsurf vs Cursor: existing Windsurf users reviewing product continuity and an editor alternative.

sections.heading: Resolve identity before features
paragraphs: If you already use Windsurf, capture your current plan and ask the vendor how your editor, credits and account transfer. A new buyer should not treat the old product name as proof of a current purchasable plan.

sections.heading: Compare only confirmed entitlements
paragraphs: After the account transition is understood, compare one repository change and the controls you actually receive. Until then, a numeric winner would hide the largest uncertainty in this decision.

sections.heading: When neither is a fit
paragraphs: If your required security, data location or operating environment is not supported by current evidence, pause the purchase. Use the sources below to resolve the missing constraint before accepting a recommendation.

verdict: Do not choose on historical price comparisons: Windsurf sources now redirect to Devin and account continuity needs confirmation.
bestFor: Existing Windsurf users reviewing product continuity and an editor alternative
notFor: New buyers expecting a current Windsurf price from historical research
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.

pros.text: The vendor identifies Devin Desktop as the new name for Windsurf and says the full IDE remains available after the standard update.
Cursor documents an editor and coding-agent workflow with its own MCP setup and approval controls.

cons.text: The product page describes a standard Windsurf-to-Devin Desktop transition, but this review has not tested an individual account or its entitlement.
A current plan quote is still needed before comparing spend; do not transfer a historic Windsurf amount or a Cursor base plan into a workload estimate.

faqs.question: Is Devin Desktop the new name for Windsurf?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current official FAQ says Devin Desktop is the new name for Windsurf and describes plans, pricing, extensions and settings as carrying over with the standard over-the-air update.

faqs.question: Does that establish the exact monthly cost of a Windsurf-to-Cursor switch?
faqs.answer: No. The vendor describes account continuity, not a shared price basis. Confirm the current plan and usage terms for each account before comparing.
